subject.title: [perf]: sessions.json unbounded growth causes gateway OOM — skillsSnapshot duplicated per session, no pruning of ephemeral sessions

question: Should this issue remain the umbrella closure gate for the gateway session-store OOM family, or should maintainers decompose and close it in favor of focused trackers?
rationale: Current source and live related issues show multiple partial fixes and remaining policy choices; automation cannot safely choose the durable storage, cleanup, and closure boundary for a broad stability tracker.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Gate
options.body: Keep this issue open as the broad tracker until focused fixes for prompt-report bloat, cache retention, temp cleanup, transcript bounds, and soak proof are resolved.

options.title: Close Into Focused Trackers
options.body: Close this issue as superseded only after maintainers confirm each remaining failure mode has a canonical open issue or merged fix with preserved context.

options.title: Narrow Scope
options.body: Retitle or comment to narrow this issue to one remaining root cause, such as session-store metadata duplication, and route other memory reports elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Gate
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the broad tracker until focused fixes for prompt-report bloat, cache retention, temp cleanup, transcript bounds, and soak proof are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest current routing signal for the session-store files and the storage-policy tradeoff surfaced by the review.
